visible_text: 決まったことを待っています…
やることを待っています…
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く

answers.q1: Mostly one surface, but not fully: the small rounded pill at the very top (record dot, pause, chat, expand, more, stop) overlaps the top edge of the main card rather than sitting inside it, so it reads like a separate floating control bar/HUD stacked on top of the window. The rest — the left notes panel, the right transcript panel with its tabs, and the bottom chat input — all sit inside one continuous rounded card with a single background and a plain vertical divider, so that portion feels unified.
answers.q2: Barely. The only label is '23:32 の会議' (a generic timestamp, not a meeting title, participant list, or calendar name), and 'AI が見ている資料' at the bottom just names a category (materials) without showing which document or source is actually attached. There is no visible app name, no participant avatars, no calling/source app being captured. I cannot tell which meeting this is or what source audio is coming from.
answers.q3: It is actively recording (録音中, 00:02 elapsed, dotted waveform animating) and listening for speech ('聞いています…'), but no one has spoken yet, so every content area is a waiting state: the transcript says 'まだ発話がありません' (no speech yet), and the decisions/to-dos sections say they're waiting for content. It is waiting for the meeting's audio to actually start producing speech.
answers.q4: The recording status in the top-left ('録音中 00:02' with the red dot) — it's the only concrete, non-placeholder fact on the screen, telling you the app is live and capturing.
answers.q5: The screen is dominated by near-identical empty placeholder lines ('〜を待っています…', 'まだ発話がありません') repeated four times, which reads as visually redundant rather than informative. The floating top pill toolbar looks detached from the card beneath it. 'AI が見ている資料' is a dangling label with no visible resource attached, so its purpose is unclear at this stage.

weaknesses.what: The only identifier for the meeting is a generic auto-generated timestamp title ('23:32 の会議'); there is no participant, source app, or calendar-event context anywhere on screen.
weaknesses.fix: Show the actual meeting/event title or participant names when available, or at least the audio source (app/mic) being captured.

weaknesses.what: The small capsule toolbar at the top overlaps and sits proud of the main card's top edge, visually detaching it as a floating overlay rather than part of the same surface.
weaknesses.fix: Recess the toolbar into the card's own header or give it a shared shadow/edge treatment so it reads as one continuous surface.

weaknesses.what: Four separate empty-state messages (transcript, decisions, to-dos, and implicitly the resource link) compete at similar visual weight with no single focal point while waiting for speech.
weaknesses.fix: Collapse or de-emphasize the empty sections and give the single 'listening' state more visual priority until real content arrives.
